mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as FEDFUNDS is a continuous predictor of equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2% signals elevated inflation expectations, triggering reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL change > 0.2% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL change > 0.2% (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market overheating occurs when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth slows below 0.5% annually, triggering monetary tightening expectations that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5 AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5% (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (annualized GDP growth > 2.0%) indicates overvaluation and monetary tightening anticipation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annually (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% monthly signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5% (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals a cooling housing market, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0 (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (as measured by 20-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2% signals elevated inflation expectations, triggering immediate market reactions that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL change > 0.2% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL change > 0.2% (as measured by 5-day return direction), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
